name: Rotate Recovery Codes
summary: The user confirms recovery-code rotation; the server replaces the old recovery-code set and returns fresh codes for display.

preconditions.expression: user is authenticated, TOTP is enabled, and recovery-code rotation has been explicitly confirmed

serverInteraction.intent: Invalidate the current recovery-code set exactly once, issue a fresh set, and return the plaintext codes for immediate presentation.

postconditions.expression: TOTP remains enabled and only the newly issued recovery codes are valid

sourceReferences.note: RotateRecoveryCodesAsync is the single server operation and returns the newly generated recovery-code list.
The bound integration proof exercises the real flow service, typed rotation handler and AppUserMfaManager and verifies fresh-code issuance, preserved TOTP state and the declared auth-log events.
Runner setup now materializes authentic TOTP and recovery-code state through the real begin and confirm enrollment operations when HasTOTP is set.
